checks.purpose: 赫菲类型检查、单元及集成测试和干净构建（G1：排除 tests/acceptance/，与独立的 acceptance 检查互斥；原命令为 pnpm check，此处显式复刻为 typecheck + vitest --exclude + build）
args: cd hephi && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm typecheck && pnpm exec vitest run --exclude 'tests/acceptance/**' && pnpm build

checks.purpose: G1 acceptance check (T08 §8 pattern): run only hephi/tests/acceptance, JUnit report in this run directory. Assumes vitest's built-in junit reporter and acceptance tests under hephi/tests/acceptance/ (created by T15 tasks; not present at staging time). Installs dependencies first so this check can run before the regression check.
args: cd hephi && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec vitest run tests/acceptance --reporter=junit --outputFile="$HEPHI_RUN_DIR/junit.xml"
